summary:
The 4th Marine Regiment (Amf 4) is a Swedish Amphibious Corps unit based in Gothenburg. Formed in 2000 from the Älvsborg Coastal Artillery Regiment, it trained amphibious forces after Sweden ended its fixed coastal artillery.

Amf 4 was disbanded in 2004, when the government chose to concentrate amphibious training at the 1st Marine Regiment near Stockholm. A detachment remained in Gothenburg, maintaining a local military presence and coastal capabilities.

The regiment was reinstated on 1 October 2021. It took over existing patrol-boat and naval-security companies and established a marine battalion. Its current units are the 5th Marine Battalion, the 17th Patrol Boat Company and the 132nd Naval Security Company.
